faultLoc.explanation: The NullPointerException is thrown because the code attempts to call `booleanValue()` on a `null` element in the `array`. The test case `assertArrayEquals(new boolean[]{true,false},ArrayUtils.toPrimitive(new Boolean[]{Boolean.TRUE,null}));` demonstrates this issue. The method does not handle `null` elements in the input array properly.

This line is part of the loop that iterates over the input array. The issue arises within this loop when it encounters a `null` element. Proper handling of `null` elements should be added within this loop.
